Name: Rasmodia - Seasonal Recolors
Author: JohnnyCage1234
Description:
[center][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][u]Seasonal [/u][/size][/color][color=#1e84cc][size=4][u]Rasmodia[/u][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][u] [/u][/size][/color][color=#6aa84f][size=4][u]for[/u][/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][u] [/u][/size][/color][color=#cc0000][size=4][u]SVE[/u][/size][/color][/b]

(Pretty much just different hair colors for different seasons)[/center]

Gives Rasmodia different hair colors for different seasons based on the seasonal variants of the Wizard. Now updated for the latest version of Romanceable Rasmodia (at least as of 3/29/24). Also includes green hair for the Flower Dance!
[u]
[color=#ffff00][size=5][b][i]MAKE SURE YOU HAVE ROMANCEABLE RASMODIA AND SVE INSTALLED![/i][/b]
[/size][/color]
[/u][color=#ff7700][size=4][u][b]Install Directions:[/b][/u][/size][/color][size=3]
[/size]1) Install Required Files:
﻿a) Romanceable Rasmodia (and all of its requirements)
﻿b) Stardew Valley Expanded (and all of its requirements)
2) Download and unzip the file under the "files" tab
3) Drag it into mod folder

[size=4][b]Credits
[/b][/size][size=3]Nom0ri for the artwork - I just altered the color schemes for the portraits and sprites. [/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=3]CreepyKat for the original mod/artwork as well.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]Poltergeister for the original seasonal designs.[/size][size=4]
[/size]
